goal: Separate CGKN into explicit API-only and Codex-supervised runtime profiles with isolated state, one shared reviewed Provider delivery mainline, and no mixed one-shot plus persistent Codex control.
acceptance_criteria: Both profiles retain the same Provider output validation, evidence, local_packager, public delivery gate, and delivery manifest route.
Interface requests in API-only mode reach user design confirmation without creating a Codex escalation.
Kernel, runtime-supervisor, Codex conversation-design, and documentation checks pass.
The API-only launcher starts the reviewed API Provider route with Codex design and runtime supervision disabled.
The Codex-supervised launcher starts one persistent supervisor thread and forces the historical one-shot Codex design CLI off.
The two profiles isolate sessions, logs, uploads, project memory, Provider candidate roots, and supervisor state.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: schema validation, deterministic contract tests, support-pipeline prompt tests, and an offline failed-generation replay

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: scripts/start_cgkn_api_only.ps1 always passes generation-mode api, codex-design-mode disabled, and supervision-policy disabled.
scripts/start_cgkn_codex_supervised.ps1 always starts scripts.cgkn_runtime_supervisor with a dedicated state directory and runtime-data root.
cgkn_runtime_supervisor._default_codex_argv always forces the child bridge's one-shot Codex design mode to disabled.
codex_conversation API-only design handling reaches awaiting_user_confirmation without creating a CGKNCodexCapabilityEscalation.
Both profiles dispatch formal generation only through run_provider_generation_job and retain local_packager as the sole delivery exit.

feedback: Two mutually exclusive public runtime profiles now have explicit launchers, isolated state, and one unchanged formal Provider delivery mainline.

worked: Separating operational profiles at the launcher and child-process boundary removed accidental one-shot plus persistent Codex mixing without duplicating generation.
did_not_work: The pre-cleanup direct script invocation in README could fail package imports and the request-only default could leave API-only interface work waiting for a Codex brief.
experiments: Run one private-chat smoke in each profile and compare process trees plus profile directories before considering live operations evaluated.
